roles.title: Innkeeper
roles.greeting: Welcome, traveller! Ale's cold, stew's hot, and the beds have only a few fleas.

roles.title: Contract Board
roles.greeting: Parchments flutter on rusty nails. Bounties, hunts, and desperate pleas for help.

roles.title: Merchant
roles.greeting: Everything a hero needs, at prices a hero can almost afford.

roles.title: Blacksmith
roles.greeting: Steel, sweat and sparks. Want something forged to your liking?

roles.title: Enchanter
roles.greeting: Bring me essences and I'll bind their power to your gear.

roles.title: Spell Trainer
roles.greeting: Magic is a language. Let me teach you a few words.

roles.title: Healer
roles.greeting: Wounds, curses, embarrassing itches... I've seen it all. No judgement here.

roles.title: Barber
roles.greeting: Sit down, sit down! Let's make you look like a hero instead of a swamp troll.

roles.title: Stablemaster
roles.greeting: Every adventurer needs a friend that doesn't talk back. Mostly.

roles.title: Exotic Beast Dealer
roles.greeting: Psst. You look like someone who appreciates... rare creatures. No questions asked.

roles.title: Quartermaster
roles.greeting: Prove your worth to us and our armouries are open to you.

roles.title: Town Guard
roles.greeting: Move along, citizen. Keep your blade sheathed inside the walls.

roles.title: Citizen
roles.greeting: Lovely day for it, isn't it? Mind the river — the Vltara swallows a drunk a week.

roles.title: King of Velhrad
roles.greeting: Ah, an adventurer. My kingdom has need of steel. Earn the Crown's favour and you'll be rewarded.

rumors: They say a beast with propellers for wings was seen over the Mire. Swearing, apparently.
The Catacombs under St. Vojtech rearrange themselves when nobody's looking. Bring chalk.
Frostholm folk claim the Frozen King still sits on his throne, waiting.
The Ashborn are buying up every sulfur stone in the realm. Nothing good comes of that.
Rosa's cheap, sure. But ask the guards why they all walk funny.
A smith can forge you anything, if you bring the right ore and enough coin.
Tame a beast when it's weak — a rope and a kind word go a long way.
The Brotherhood pays for favours. The Crown pays for heads. Choose wisely.
The astronomical clock on the Old Town Hall has not been wrong in three hundred years. Only late.
